objective: Reproducible Cosmos3-Nano LIBERO-10 WAM post-training blog with measured Slurm single-node and multi-node results
hardware: STRICT reserved NVIDIA B200, us-central1; 8 GPUs per fabric-connected VM
scheduler: Native Slurm on dedicated GPU VMs; controller and accounting colocated on the first worker

timing_replicates.purpose: Measure steady-state and run-to-run variability separately from observed full-schedule duration

profiling.include: PyTorch CPU/CUDA timelines, collectives, VAE/input preparation, memory and GPU telemetry

quality.action_semantics: 20 Hz, frame_wise_relative rot6d, quantile_rot, concat front+wrist, native coordinate frame
quality.threshold_definition: 90 percent overall success across all 500 trials
quality.time_to_quality: First scheduled checkpoint meeting threshold; report the preceding checkpoint interval, not an unobserved exact crossing
quality.checkpoint_selection: Evaluate 500, 1000, 1500 and 2000 checkpoints for each full run; include all task counts and failures
quality.visuals: Actual successful and unsuccessful simulator rollouts tied to checkpoint hashes

publication: Update existing draft PR and blog with measured claims; never substitute inference duration for training duration or extrapolation for observed completion
